def Solve(n):
    a=-1
    b=1000000000
    while(b-a>1):
        e=(b+a)//2
        x=(e*(e+1))//2
        if(x>=n):
            b=e
        else:
            a=e
    x=(b*(b+1))//2
    while((x-n)%2!=0):
        b+=1
        x+=b
    return b
